title: platecli job/send success or dry-run envelope

size_verified.description: False when the printer omitted FTPS SIZE after upload.

plate.description: Plate of a pre-sliced 3MF chosen for printing.

plan_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the canonical plan (printer, source, local file content, slice and print options). Pass it to --expect-plan on the real run to refuse if anything changed since review.

mode.description: auto (best-ranked face), keep (the file's own pose) or face (--face N). keep with a warning: auto could not read the file, so it was sliced as exported.

changed.description: True when platecli rotated the model.

turned.description: The turn from the file's pose in words, e.g. '90° about X'; null when it lies as exported.

rotation.description: 3x3 rotation applied to the file's coordinates (v' = R·v), row by row.

face.description: Ranked face (1-based, as 'plate orient' lists them) the model lies on, if any.

rotations.description: --rotate steps applied after the face, in order, e.g. ['x=90'].

presliced.description: True for a pre-sliced 3MF: its pose is never changed.

bed_contact_mm2.description: Area of the model resting on the bed.

overhang_mm2.description: Down-facing area steeper than 45° past vertical.

stable.description: Whether its centre of mass sits over what touches the bed.

warning.description: Say this to the person: the kept pose rests on a point or an edge, or auto could not run.

orientation.description: How a sliced model was stood on the bed.
